name: Aziza
overview: Aziza is a male descendant of Zattu mentioned in the book of Ezra. His unique attribute is that he had married a foreign wife, a detail noted in Ezra 10:27. There is no tribal affiliation or additional personal information recorded about him in Scripture.
namesAndTitles: The name Aziza means "powerful." This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but reflects a characteristic meaning found in the original Hebrew context, as noted in Ezra 10:27.
familyAndRelationships: Aziza is explicitly identified as a descendant of Zattu. Beyond this, Scripture does not record any further family relationships for him apart from the fact that he married a foreign wife.
scriptureSignificance: Aziza's significance lies in his mention during the post-exilic period when the Israelites were addressing the issue of intermarriage with foreign wives. His inclusion highlights the challenges faced by returning exiles in maintaining covenantal purity according to Mosaic law. This reflects the broader theme of restoration and obedience in the book of Ezra.
